notes: The area-choice block combines four printed areas: Area 1 History or Government (HIST 028, 029, 031, 037, POLS 005); Area 2 Arts and Humanities (Art 012, CINA 011, ENGL 036, MUSC 013); Area 3 Social Science (ANTH 002, CDFS 053, COMM 012, PSYC 007, PSYC 034); Area 4 Quantitative Reasoning and Research Methods (STAT C1000).
